summary: Risk rating CRITICAL: Transaction with a counterparty lacking verified KYC; High-risk jurisdiction stated but not named; Cross-border payment information.

transaction.description: Cross-border payment of $2M to a non-KYC verified entity in a high-risk jurisdiction

findings.title: Transaction with a counterparty lacking verified KYC
findings.rationale: The counterparty has not completed KYC, and customer due diligence applies to international money transfers.
required_actions: Hold the transaction until customer due diligence is complete.
Identify and verify the beneficial owner of the counterparty.
Ask the Principal Officer to consider a Suspicious Transaction Report.

findings.title: High-risk jurisdiction stated but not named
findings.rationale: The description says high-risk, but the list status cannot be confirmed until the jurisdiction is named.
required_actions: Treat as high risk and apply enhanced due diligence until the jurisdiction is confirmed.

findings.title: Cross-border payment information
findings.rationale: Cross-border transfers must carry complete originator and beneficiary information.
required_actions: Confirm that complete originator and beneficiary information accompanies the transfer.
Retain transaction records for at least five years.
